description: This Python source file contains classes and methods for transforming and validating requests and responses related to AWS Bedrock's CountTokens API, specifically converting between Anthropic message formats and Bedrock's API formats, and constructing API endpoints.

classes.name: BedrockCountTokensConfig
classes.description: Handles configuration, request transformation, response transformation, endpoint construction, and validation for AWS Bedrock CountTokens API.

methods.name: _detect_input_type
methods.description: Detects whether the request uses 'converse' or 'invokeModel' input format based on request data.

methods.name: transform_anthropic_to_bedrock_count_tokens
methods.description: Transforms an Anthropic-formatted request into Bedrock CountTokens API format, supporting both 'converse' and 'invokeModel' types.

methods.name: _transform_to_converse_format
methods.description: Converts message list into Bedrock 'converse' input format, handling system and user messages.

methods.name: _transform_to_invoke_model_format
methods.description: Converts request data into Bedrock 'invokeModel' format with raw JSON body.

methods.name: get_bedrock_count_tokens_endpoint
methods.description: Constructs the AWS Bedrock CountTokens API endpoint URL based on model and region.

methods.name: transform_bedrock_response_to_anthropic
methods.description: Converts Bedrock CountTokens API response to Anthropic format.

methods.name: validate_count_tokens_request
methods.description: Validates the structure and required fields of the count tokens request for both 'converse' and 'invokeModel' formats.
